newsitem.title: GERMANY: German builders union to holds manual pay talks.
newsitem.headline: German builders union to holds manual pay talks.

text.p: Germany's IG Bau building sector union confirmed on Monday it would still hold talks with one of the large industry bodies over efforts to bring east German construction wages into line with those in the west.

IG Bau said in a statement it would negotiate with the Zentralverband des deutschen Baugewerbes, representing firms employing mainly manual workers, because it had not joined an industry move to scrap earlier agreements on the issue.
IG BAU earlier said it could not negotiate with firms that were now ignoring east German wage agreements until after a court ruling to determine whether they were acting legally.

The union is planning to organise a "campaign of information" in October to protest against the decision in August by the Hauptverband der Deutschen Bauindustrie, the main sector body, to scrap previously-agreed deals.
The agreements would have brought east German wages up to some 95 percent of western levels this October.
